authority_boundaries.rule: The only currently established LNG-01 starter language/stage stable identities are the governed Dominix future-reference entries. No recovered RSR-06 source is silently mapped to any `language:dominix:*` or `stage:dominix:*` identity.
Owner-authored or source-visible proper names preserve exact string provenance only; a proper name does not establish a language, pronunciation, etymology, naming grammar or script.
Assistant-generated claims such as `Common`, `Goblin`, multilingualism or language proficiency remain proposals; they do not create stable language IDs, fluency, literacy or intelligibility.
A glyph, rune, sigil, symbol, written mark or visual code mention does not automatically create an LNG script identity or language/script association.

Supernatural speech, spirit/dead/fungal communication, telepathy, emotional communication and magical language conditions route to RSR-07/MSS for mechanism; they do not automatically create Character language knowledge or accepted linguistic content.
The owner-supported Serpent negative-emotion telepathy statement is preserved as communication-mode evidence only; no spoken language, lexicon, script, grammar or translation is inferred.
Translation implants, devices, occupations or infrastructure do not establish source/target language identities, accepted translations, fluency or universal translation capability.
Nonlinguistic uses of `translate`, including translating abilities or mechanics between systems, are not LNG linguistic translation evidence.
Assistant-generated mottos, chants, hymns, riddles, countersigns and phrases are not accepted lexicon/phrase records merely because they appear in recovered prose.
LNG-01 future/historical-stage quarantine remains mandatory before speech, naming, Character/NPC knowledge, search, translation, summaries or AI context; RSR-06 cannot weaken it.
Culture, species, faction, geography or historical proximity does not imply language-family descent, dialect/register membership or intelligibility without explicit accepted evidence.
Assistant-generated proper names and linguistic-looking labels remain proposal-only unless independently supported or later owner-approved.
Post-scarcity language-preservation and identity/name-change models remain generic social proposals and do not establish canonical language or naming mechanics.

Culture, species, faction, World/Reality/Timeline and Character associations remain references to their owning domains; RSR-06 creates no duplicate culture, World, species, faction or Character ledger.
